title: {enemy:brute}
text:
一个{enemy:brute}挡在路上，皮糙肉厚。

带着{faith:brute}的第一阶打这一场：血掉得越多，你打得越狠，留意回放里的数字。打完信力该过 {faith_threshold:brute:2} 了。

texts.en:
A {enemy:brute} blocks the road. Thick hide.

Fight this one at Rank one of {faith:brute}: the more Health you lose, the harder you hit. Watch the numbers in the replay. By the end your Faith should be past {faith_threshold:brute:2}.

options.label: 进入战前准备
options.hint_when_hidden: 你现在信的不是{faith:brute}：右键{item:charm_brute}切回来再打。

hints_when_hidden.en: You're not following {faith:brute} right now. Right-click the {item:charm_brute} to switch back, then fight.
